from PIL import Image
import struct, io, os

SRC = 'D:/OneDrive/Desktop/ego-blockchain-/ego-desktop-mvp/src-tauri/icons/ego_square.png'
OUT = 'D:/OneDrive/Desktop/ego-blockchain-/ego-desktop-mvp/src-tauri/icons/icon.ico'

src = Image.open\(SRC\).convert\('RGBA'\)

# Build ICO manually - most reliable way
sizes = [16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 128, 256]
pngs = []
for sz in sizes:
    img = src.resize\(\(sz, sz\), Image.LANCZOS\)
    buf = io.BytesIO\(\)
    img.save\(buf, format='PNG'\)
    pngs.append\(buf.getvalue\(\)\)

# ICO format: header \(6\) + directory entries \(16*n\) + image data
n = len\(sizes\)
header = struct.pack\('<HHH', 0, 1, n\)  # reserved, type=1 \(ICO\), count

# Calculate offsets
dir_size = n * 16
data_offset = 6 + dir_size

entries = b''
offset = data_offset
for i, \(sz, png\) in enumerate\(zip\(sizes, pngs\)\):
    w = 0 if sz == 256 else sz  # 256 is encoded as 0 in ICO format
    h = 0 if sz == 256 else sz
    entries += struct.pack\('<BBBBHHII', w, h, 0, 0, 1, 32, len\(png\), offset\)
    offset += len\(png\)

with open\(OUT, 'wb'\) as f:
    f.write\(header\)
    f.write\(entries\)
    for png in pngs:
        f.write\(png\)

print\(f'Written: {os.path.getsize\(OUT\):,} bytes'\)

# Verify
with open\(OUT, 'rb'\) as f:
    data = f.read\(\)
count = struct.unpack_from\('<H', data, 4\)[0]
print\(f'ICO layers: {count}'\)
for i in range\(count\):
    off = 6 + i*16
    w, h = data[off], data[off+1]
    if w==0: w=256
    if h==0: h=256
    print\(f'  {w}x{h}'\)
EOF)

import struct, io, os

SRC = 'D:/OneDrive/Desktop/ego-blockchain-/ego-desktop-mvp/public/egoc.png'
DIR = 'D:/OneDrive/Desktop/ego-blockchain-/ego-desktop-mvp/src-tauri/icons'

for fname, sz in [\('32x32.png',32\),\('64x64.png',64\),\('128x128.png',128\),\('128x128@2x.png',256\),\('icon.png',256\)]:
    src.resize\(\(sz,sz\), Image.LANCZOS\).save\(os.path.join\(DIR, fname\), 'PNG'\)
    print\(f'  {fname}'\)

# Build ICO manually with all Windows sizes
sizes = [16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 128, 256]
pngs = []
for sz in sizes:
    buf = io.BytesIO\(\)
    src.resize\(\(sz,sz\), Image.LANCZOS\).save\(buf, 'PNG'\)
    pngs.append\(buf.getvalue\(\)\)

header = struct.pack\('<HHH', 0, 1, n\)
offset = 6 + n * 16
entries = b''
for sz, png in zip\(sizes, pngs\):

    entries += struct.pack\('<BBBBHHII', w, w, 0, 0, 1, 32, len\(png\), offset\)
    offset += len\(png\)

with open\(os.path.join\(DIR, 'icon.ico'\), 'wb'\) as f:
    f.write\(header + entries\)
    for png in pngs: f.write\(png\)
